Campaigns.//IncludeStatuses: Live counts: VALIDATED 308, REALIZED 45, INPROGRESS 7, FAILED 8. Empty reproduces the Power BI report, which counted all four. Decide deliberately - see README.
Campaigns.//IncludeProjects: Only ZOOVCH exists today, so no filter is needed. Set this if a second project is ever loaded.
Campaigns.//CategoryRules: Mirrors the SWITCH(TRUE()) in the model's 'Drilling Detail Category' DAX, arm for arm, in order. First match wins; an empty list is a wildcard. Note DrillPurpose is not used, and Hybrid is a PRODUCT/INJECT hole that was also cored.

CategoryRules.//: INPROGRESS is absent here, faithfully to the DAX. No hydro hole is in progress today, so it changes nothing now; the first one that is will read as Other until it is validated.

Campaigns.//FallbackCategory: Known HOLEPURPOSE, status accepted by no rule - the 8 FAILED holes. Their metres still count; they just have no category.
Campaigns.//Donuts: The four the report drew, in display order. Other is included so the donuts sum exactly to the Holes drilled card - it is the FAILED holes, 7 of them in 2026. Ra-Grade has no 2026 holes and so no donut. Metric is CoredSplit (cored vs destructive metres) or ShareOfCampaign (this category's metres vs the rest). All four use CoredSplit: the hole count in the centre of each donut carries the information, so Techno reading 100% destructive is simply a fact about technological wells rather than an empty chart.
